source: Official IYAC North standings through November 6, Explore’s November 9 result against CASA, and the commissioner’s six-game clarification

forecasts.label: Make playoffs
forecasts.detail: Clinched. Explore’s 4–2 record cannot fall below the North top three.

forecasts.label: Miss playoffs
forecasts.detail: Mathematically impossible under the confirmed top-three qualification rule.

forecasts.label: Finish North #2
forecasts.detail: Guaranteed if Scholars loses its final game; also likely if head-to-head breaks a 4–2 tie because Explore beat Scholars.

forecasts.label: Finish North #3
forecasts.detail: Possible only if Scholars wins to reach 4–2 and the league uses a tiebreak that favors Scholars over Explore.

forecasts.label: Reach championship match
forecasts.detail: Explore has beaten Sueño Park twice and Scholars, but the bracket and byes remain unpublished.

forecasts.label: Win championship
forecasts.detail: Explore has championship-level wins, but the losses to Milestones and CASA show meaningful consistency risk.

forecastNote: Qualification is certain, not estimated. The seed ranges reflect two unknowns: Scholars’ final result and the league’s unpublished tiebreak order. Explore finishes #2 if Scholars loses. If Scholars wins and reaches 4–2, Explore is still #2 under a head-to-head tiebreak because Explore defeated Scholars; another tiebreak could place Explore #3. Final and championship ranges are model estimates, not official league probabilities.
notes: All records on this page are shown as wins first, losses second.
Explore finished 8 wins and 2 losses across all scheduled matches and 4 wins and 2 losses in the six-game record used for playoff ranking.
Explore’s six official games are its five North opponents plus the assigned official crossover against Edison.
Only one Milestones meeting counts officially: the October 19 loss. The September 23 victory is part of the all-game record but not the playoff record.
CASA defeated Explore 2–0 on November 9. The individual set scores are intentionally not published.
The November 4 Sueño Park rematch was a 2–1 Explore victory and changes only the all-game record.
Top three from each division reach one combined six-team playoff.
Explore has clinched a top-three North finish at 4–2. Painted Rock can finish no better than 3–3, CASA finished 3–3, and Synergy can finish no better than 2–4.
The playoff schedule is expected by Thursday, November 12. ADP will host volleyball, but the league has not yet published the bracket, byes, cross-division seeding, or tiebreak order.
The regular season is scheduled to end November 12, playoffs are scheduled for the week of November 16, and the championship is tentatively scheduled for Thursday, November 19 at ADP.

Explore’s known played-set record is 14 wins and 6 losses. The exact second-set score against Scholars and both CASA set scores remain unpublished, so the page does not invent a complete season point margin.
